Ticket 16 — where should the upper line sit?

Every card is a detected setup, drawn over the primary window only. Two candidate upper boundaries are drawn on each: A and B. They are the same two fitting methods on every card, but which one is A is randomised per card, so you cannot follow a colour. Pick the line that sits where you would have drawn it — the line you would hang a price alert on. neither is a real answer and worth using.

Candles piercing the line is fine and expected (§3.2). The dashed red level is the stop (the base low); it is the same under both.
